Game Overview

Twilight Tails is a adventure game built around embark on an enchanting cooperative adventure as nocturnal animals, each with special skills, to outwit the mischievous Sock Goblin. Traverse vibrant forests, underground tunnels, and treetops, solving clever puzzles with teamwork. Prepare for an epic showdown and reclaim your stolen laundry in this captivating, strategic mission.
